name: Notion MCP
summary: Notion's hosted remote MCP server that lets MCP clients search, read and write in your Notion workspace.
description: Notion recommends the remote server at `https://mcp.notion.com/mcp`; the open-source local server (makenotion/notion-mcp-server) receives limited support. The MIT license covers the open-source local server; Notion recommends the hosted Remote Notion MCP.
